## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, …)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs / ADR updated if this changes a significant decision
- [ ] If a payload shape changed: `CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION` bumped and a migration added
